column1: # Git repositories for ark-git.sh (shallow clones; hooks, submodules and symlinks off).
# ClamAV signatures (core) and the optional GitHub archive (ARK_GITHUB_TOP=<count>) are built in.
# Fields are separated by ONE tab. Use - for an empty field. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# tier: core (downloaded by default), optional, or giant. Choose with ARK_TIERS="core optional".
